name: Enrolls Account
description: An AWS Organizations organization enrolls a member account (organization -> account): the organization-wide membership listed by organizations:ListAccounts, whichever OU the account currently sits in. Organization-level on purpose: MoveAccount changes an account's OU (NESTED_UNDER_PARENT) and never its membership, so a moved account is not mistaken for a departed one. The organization declares it in CONTAINMENT_EDGES; an account that leaves the organization (or is finally removed after closure) drops out of the listing and becomes a retirement candidate, while a closed or suspended account is still listed and stays live with its status. Retiring an account ends its BELONGS_TO_ACCOUNT edges and cascades to nothing else: the account declares no containment.
